# h3_vpc_route (Resource)

A route of the VPC route table: traffic to `destination` goes to a VM or an address inside the VPC (VPN gateway, firewall, NAT appliance) or is dropped (`blackhole`). The default route `0.0.0.0/0` belongs to the egress mode of the VPC and cannot be set here. The destination must not overlap the VPC networks or platform ranges; at most 50 routes per VPC. Free of charge. Every argument change replaces the route.

The VM that receives the traffic must forward it (IP forwarding in the guest) and its security group must allow the routed networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Office network behind a VPN gateway VM of the VPC
resource "h3_vpc_route" "office" {
  vpc_id      = h3_vpc.main.id
  destination = "10.50.0.0/16"
  target_type = "vm"
  vm_id       = h3_vm.vpn_gw.id
  description = "IPsec to the office"
}

# Part of the office network that must stay unreachable from the cloud
resource "h3_vpc_route" "office_mgmt" {
  vpc_id      = h3_vpc.main.id
  destination = "10.50.250.0/24"
  target_type = "blackhole"
}

# Next hop by address (e.g. a VRRP address of two firewall VMs)
resource "h3_vpc_route" "partner" {
  vpc_id      = h3_vpc.main.id
  destination = "172.20.0.0/16"
  target_type = "ip"
  next_hop_ip = "10.0.0.250"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination IPv4 CIDR, e.g. `10.50.0.0/16` (an address means /32)
- `target_type` (String) `vm` (a VM of the project in this VPC, `vm_id`), `ip` (a host address of a VPC network, `next_hop_ip`) or `blackhole`
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (equals the project ID)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text, up to 255 characters
- `next_hop_ip` (String) Next hop address. Required for `ip`; for `vm` it is the address of the VM, filled by the platform.
- `vm_id` (String) VM ID for `target_type = "vm"`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Route ID
- `status` (String) `active` (in the VPC router) or `pending`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<vpc_id>/<route_id>"
terraform import h3_vpc_route.office <vpc_id>/<route_id>
```
